inputs.prompt: Image 2 is a coloured stick-figure pose skeleton. Draw the woman from image 1 standing in that exact pose, at the same size and position in the frame as the skeleton, with empty background around her: her whole figure fits inside the frame, her tall updo, both shoes, both hands and the whole upright bass from its scroll to its spike fully visible with margin on every side. seen from exactly the same angle as image 1, with the same stance and the same way of facing, both feet flat on the floor, the bass exactly where it is in image 1, upright on its spike in front of her, her shoulders swaying a little toward the left of the picture, plucking hard. She keeps her very tall, rangy, long-limbed adult build, long narrow face with soft smile lines, calm eyes, closed easy smile, deep brown skin, silver-white hair in a tall smooth rounded updo, long-sleeved cream dinner jacket buttoned closed, its narrow midnight-violet satin lapels lying flat on the chest, a small midnight-violet bow tie at a closed cream shirt collar, slim dark charcoal trousers and polished two-tone cream and dark shoes, and thick dark ink outline, with a big honey-amber wooden upright double bass as tall as she is, with a dark fingerboard, four strings and a curled scroll, exactly as in image 1. Same pixel art style with crisp pixel clusters and cel shading. She has exactly two arms and two hands, each hand complete with fingers. She is a grown woman of about sixty-five. She plays with bare fingers only and nothing else in her hands. The bass stands on the floor on its spike in front of her, on the right of the picture, its neck rising past her shoulder to the height of her head, and it stays the same size and colour. The bass is turned the same way: its strings and f-holes face the lower right corner of the picture, and its wooden side ribs show along its left edge. Do not draw the skeleton. Plain light grey background, full body.
